Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Experimental test partner: summon a minion and load a Mare character file (.mcdf) under Settings > Experimental. On your screen only it becomes that character, stands on your spot and plays the other role of your animation, so you can test couple animations alone.
